Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparison logic, stating “The film with the larger age value has the younger director,” which is the opposite of true (a larger age means an older director). This flawed rule would directly lead to selecting the wrong film. Additionally, the Planner drifted from the earlier correct criterion (compare birth years) to comparing ages at release, compounding the error.
